items.evidence: Replay of the bot's winning script (seed 1, Normal) to tick 6300: wave 6, runner {kind runner, health 1}, score 555 = 450 + 7x15. Easy replay showed two runners 4.5 units apart (90 ticks x 0.05/tick = 3 u/s, one every 1.5 s). The win at 6960 scored 675 = 450 + 15x15, so 15 runners.

HUD 'Wave 1 of 6' / 'Oleada 1 de 6' / 'Vague 1 sur 6' and 'Wave 6 of 6' in the frame. After wave 5 the run stayed in play at wave 6. Full replay: won, 675, gate 5. With the last shot removed, the last runner went through the gate: won, 660, gate 4.

Right on Language goes en->es->fr->en, Left from en goes to fr. In French: title 'Défendez la porte/Commencer/Réglages/Quitter', settings 'Réglages/Volume : 5/Langue : Français/Difficulté : Difficile/Retour', play/paused 'Score : 0/Vague 1 sur 6/Santé de la porte : 5/Pause/Reprendre/Titre', lost 'Vous avez perdu/Score final : 0/Entrée : titre', won 'Vous avez gagné/Score final : 660'. Frames agree.

Settings texts are [Settings, Volume, Language, Difficulty: Normal, Back] and Difficulty is menu_index 2. Right x2 gives hard (clamped), Left x3 gives easy. In French: 'Difficulté : Difficile' / 'Facile'. The frame marks '> Difficulty: Hard <'.
Wave 1 walkers: easy health 1, normal 2, hard 3. Runners: easy replay 1, normal replay 1, Hard bot (autoplay --difficulty hard, stopped at tick 7000 in wave 6) 2.
Run 1 set volume 7, es, easy. Run 2 with the same --settings started at title with 7/es/easy. A fresh folder gave 5/en/normal. An old settings.json {volume 3, language es} loaded as 3/es/normal.
State has 'difficulty' and walkers have 'kind' (walker/runner). Every --frame PNG written was 800 x 480 (header checked on 20 frames).
Every m-item was re-run and still passes (see the m-items below).

CHANGES.md lists the three changes with files and functions (lib.rs WAVES/wave_size/health_for, fr.json, hud.json m4, gate.py, autoplay.py), what was checked and how, what was not checked, and what was wrong before.

defects: README's 'What I checked' section is stale: it still reports a win of 45 walkers for 450 points in 5420 ticks, from before the sixth wave.
A headless run takes real time (about 60 ticks/s, about 2 min for a full run; the autoplay bot took about 6 min), as the README admits.
Settings are kept only by the headless runner, not when the game is played in the engine window (stated in README/CHANGES).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
